title: Connect an MCP client
intro: Each client signs in here and asks before it gets anything.
noMatch: No client matches "{query}". Use the steps for any other client.

other.name: Any other client
other.step1: Open your client's MCP or connector settings.
other.step4: Sign in here when your client asks.

http.label: Streamable HTTP
http.hint: Recommended. For clients that support remote servers.

sse.label: SSE
sse.hint: For clients that support remote servers but not Streamable HTTP.

stdio.label: stdio
stdio.hint: For clients that only run local commands. Needs Node.js.

other.key: A client that cannot sign in can use an API key instead: send it as {header}. <link>Create a key</link>

claude.step1: Open Customize > Connectors and choose Add custom connector.
claude.step2: Enter this name and URL, then choose Add.
claude.teams: On Team and Enterprise plans, an owner adds it first under Organization settings > Connectors. Works in Claude Desktop too.

claudeCode.step2: In Claude Code, run this and choose polaris to sign in:

chatgpt.step1: Open Settings > Security and login and turn on Developer mode.
chatgpt.step3: Enter this name. Under Connection, keep Server URL and paste the URL.
chatgpt.step4: Set Authentication to OAuth. No client ID or secret is needed.
chatgpt.step5: Check I understand and want to continue, then select Create.
chatgpt.step6: Sign in here when ChatGPT asks.
chatgpt.missing: If Add only offers Create plugin and Upload plugin, Developer mode is off. Those two are for packaged plugins, not for a server URL.
chatgpt.plans: Needs a Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise or Education plan, on the web. In a Business, Enterprise or Education workspace, an admin may have to allow Developer mode first.

devin.step1: Open Customize > MCPs, choose Add MCP, then Add custom MCP.
devin.step2: Enter this name, choose the HTTP transport and paste the URL. Then Save.

figma.step1: In a Figma Make chat, click Add context, hover over Connectors and select Manage.
figma.step2: On Created by you, click Create, then enter this name and URL.
figma.step3: Click Create, then Connect, and sign in here.
figma.plans: Needs a paid Figma plan. An admin can turn custom connectors off.

grok.step3: Paste this URL and sign in here when Grok asks.
grok.business: On Grok Business and Enterprise, an admin adds the connector first.

mistral.step1: Open Connectors, click + Add Connector and switch to Custom MCP Connector.
mistral.admin: Only an administrator can add a custom connector.

zapier.step1: Open Apps, click + Add connection and choose MCP Client.
zapier.step2: Paste this URL, set Transport to Streamable HTTP and OAuth to Yes.
zapier.step3: Click Yes, Continue to MCP Client and sign in here.

make.step1: Add an MCP Client module to a scenario and click Create a connection.
make.step2: Under MCP Server, choose + New MCP Server and paste this URL.
make.step3: Click Save, and sign in here if Make asks.
